villagemaster/31331.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Welcome to the continent's largest and most extensive library! The massive amount of material archived here includes everything from the authentic chronicles of the previous empire to the research notes of current magisters. Not even Oren's Ivory Tower has as many tomes as we…

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-01.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Hmm... The Stone of Commune, eh? Well, I'll give it to you if you're qualified to have it! But I need it to write my book, "Trial of Heroes - Rewards of the Legendary Pilgrimage". Do you have anything of equal value you want to trade? Will you help me? Let's see... If the leg…

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-05.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Have you brought the Divine Stone of Wisdom? Let me see it! If it's real, it will resonate with this fragment of the Stone of Commune and give me information. If not, it's a fake. I certainly don't mean to imply that you're trying to trick me, I simply must follow procedures!…

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-06.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: The stone tablet linked to that Stone of Commune is north of the Varka Silenos stronghold. Go there!

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-0a.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Our townsfolk live in mortal fear of the Raid Bosses in this area. It would be disastrous if they were to actually intrude into the village... Our only hope is to obtain the assistance of a very powerful Clan Leader! Do you know one? (This quest is only available to the Leade…

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-0b.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Your Clan's sterling reputation precedes you! How would you and your compatriots like to enhance your Clan's prestige ? I'm afraid we've fallen into a bad situation here...

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-6.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: You are no longer a clan lord -- I have nothing to ask of you. Go in peace.

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-0.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Thank you! As a matter of fact, there are several Raid bosses around here. Which one can you defeat? Ah! Of course you don't have to do so personally. There is no rule that says a clan leader must take up the sword directly. You can order your clan members to defeat a Raid Bo…

links.text: Hestia, Guardian Deity of the Hot Springs

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-0.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: The townspeople live in constant fear because of the Raid Bosses in this area. We must manufacture better arms and equipment for our guards to defeat this menace, but the materials are difficult to obtain... If there were a strong clan nearby, I would ask its clan leader. Do …

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-1.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: I have heard of your clan's exploits. Would you and your members desire to come together and enhance your clan's prestige ? Any assistance you can provide us, be it large or small, would be greatly appreciated.

links.text: "What kind of assistance do you need?"

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-8.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: You are no longer a clan lord -- I have nothing to ask of you. Go in peace.

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-4.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Are you still here? Hurry to the Primeval Isle and bring back the Tyrannosaurus Claw that I requested. Do you have any other business with me?

links.text: "No, nothing. I'll go get the material."

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-7.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Well done! We will make great use of the material that you and your clan brought back. What a tremendous feat, to capture and bring back that ferocious creature! As promised, I will spread word everywhere that the clan you lead brought down a Tyrannosaurus. Could we possibly …

links.text: "I will continue to go and get the material."

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-02.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Killing alone won't win you a stone. First, go to the Ketra Orcs advance base and meet with Wahkan, Messenger of Ketra. He'll help you form an alliance. Fight hard alongside them to win their trust. Or you could change your mind and fight for the Varka Silenos, I don't care!

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-03.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Just killing won't win you a stone. First, you must go to the Varka Silenos stronghold and meet with Naran Ashanuk, their messenger. He'll help you to form an alliance with them. You must win their trust by proving yourself in battle. Or, if you want, you can approach the Ket…

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-07.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: What a surprise! Maybe you are guided by the goddess! You wouldn't know of that, would you? So, you're a Duelist? Maybe you can meet King Van Halter someday. Alas, he is away so much he may lose his throne soon! If you're a pilgrim, get the Divine Stone of Wisdom and bring it…

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/3-08.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Hmm.. There aren't many records of this. Just a few visions... I must find out more! To find out everything I can, I must communicate with the tablet... I'm not a pilgrim, so this won't work for me. This is a genuine Stone of Commune! Take this to the Tablet of Vision north o…

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-0c.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: The local townsfolk live in mortal fear of the Raid Bosses in this area! It would be disastrous if they were to actually intrude into the village... Would you and your friends please use your power to set the minds of our townsfolk at ease? Success would give an enormous boos…

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-1.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Very good! Slay Daimon the White-Eyed and bring me his eyeballs. And remember, you don't need to do the killing yourself! Just step aside and let your Clan members do the messy work!

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-1a.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Slay Daimon the White-Eyed and bring me his eyeball. Remember, you don't need to do the killing yourself! Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

links.text: "I want to try killing another Raid Boss."

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-1b.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Excellent! I'll spread the word of your mighty Clan's defeat of Daimon the White-Eyed.

links.text: "I want to kill some more Raid Bosses!"

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-2.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Very good! Slay the Guardian Deity of Hot Springs Hestia and bring me her Fairy Stone. Of course, you won't need to get your hands bloody... Have your Clan members do the killing for you! All you need to do is collect and bring back the proof!

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-2a.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Slay Guardian Deity of Hot Springs Hestia and bring me her Fairy Stone. Remember, you need not kill the Guardian Deity of Hot Springs Hestia with your own hands. Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

links.text: "I want to try killing another Raid Boss."

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-2b.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Excellent! I'll spread the word of your mighty Clan's defeat of the Hestia, Guardian Deity of the Hot Springs.

links.text: "I want to kill some more Raid Bosses!"

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-3.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Very good! Destroy the Plague Golem and bring me the Nucleus from the Golem. Remember, you don't need to do the killing yourself! Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-3a.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Defeat the Plague Golem and bring me the Nucleus of Lesser Golem. Remember, you need not kill the Plague Golem with your own hands. Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

links.text: "I want to try killing another Raid Boss."

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-3b.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Excellent! I'll spread the word of your mighty Clan's defeat of the Plague Golem.

links.text: "I want to kill some more Raid Bosses!"

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-4.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Very good! Destroy Demon's Agent Falston and bring me Falston's Fang. Remember, you don't need to do the killing yourself! Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-4a.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Excellent! Destroy Demon's Agent Falston and bring me his Fang. Remember, you need not kill Demon's Agent Falston with your own hands. Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

links.text: "I want to try killing another Raid Boss."

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-4b.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Excellent! Destroy Demon's Agent Falston and bring me his Fang. Remember, you need not kill Demon's Agent Falston with your own hands. Just stand back and let your Clan do the work for you!

links.text: "I want to try killing another Raid Boss."

Q00509_AClansFame/31331-5.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: What? You want to quit? Oh well, I guess you and your Clan have better things to do...

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-2.htm.text: Grand Magister Valdis: We lack sufficient weapons and armor to properly equip the guards who safeguard us here. The local blacksmiths have agreed to manufacture what we need, but lack the necessary raw materials to do so. We have been searching for those materials, but without much success. I recen…

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-3.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Thank you, thank you! Legend has it that these creatures are extremely vicious... Oh, but I'm sure they will pose no more trouble to such a powerful clan than a kitten with her claws! So, will you go to the Primeval Isle and slay a Tyrannosaurus ? Naturally, we don't expect y…

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-5.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: Then I'll leave it to you. The Tyrannosaurus of the Primeval Isle is ferocious, but I will trust in you and your clan and wait. Be sure to capture it and bring back a usable claw. Well, you know the way out. Thank you!

Q00510_AClansPrestige/31331-6.html.text: Grand Magister Valdis: You wish to quit? That's too bad, but I suppose it cannot be helped. Your clan must have concerns of its own...
